The most recent Republican to be elected governor of New York was **George E. Pataki**, who won the 1994 election and took office in 1995.  
On the November 8, 1994 ballot he appeared on several cross‑endorsed lines:

| Ballot line | Party |
|-------------|-------|
| **Pataki** | Republican Party of New York |
| **Pataki** | Conservative Party of New York |
| **Pataki** | Tax Cut Now Party |

The official New York election results list these three lines for his candidacy – “**George Pataki – Republican / Conservative / Tax Cut Now**” 【Search Result 8†L6-L8】.  

Thus, when Pataki was first elected governor, his names on the ballot were under the Republican, Conservative, and Tax Cut Now parties.

The most recent Republican to be elected governor of New York was **George E. Pataki**, who won the 1994 election and took office in 1995.  
On the November 8, 1994 ballot he appeared on several cross‑endorsed lines:

| Ballot line | Party |
|-------------|-------|
| **Pataki** | Republican Party of New York |
| **Pataki** | Conservative Party of New York |
| **Pataki** | Tax Cut Now Party |

The official New York election results list these three lines for his candidacy – “**George Pataki – Republican / Conservative / Tax Cut Now**” 【Search Result 8†L6-L8】.  

Thus, when Pataki was first elected governor, his names on the ballot were under the Republican, Conservative, and Tax Cut Now parties.
